tasks.title: Renewable Energy Consumption by Source (2000–2025)
tasks.promptText:
The line graph below shows the percentage of total electricity generated from four renewable energy sources in a European country between 2000 and 2025.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

outline: Introduction: Перефразируйте условие (the proportion of electricity produced by four clean energy sources from 2000 to 2025).
Overview: Отметьте резкий рост Wind и Solar при стабильном/слегка снижающемся уровне Hydro и умеренном плато Bioenergy.
Body Paragraph 1: Опишите лидирующий рост Wind Power (с 8% до 44%) и обгон Hydropower около 2012 года.
Body Paragraph 2: Сравните быстрый скачок Solar PV (1% -> 34%) с постепенным спадом Hydropower (26% -> 21%) и пиком Bioenergy (12%).
pitfalls: Не описывайте каждый год по очереди — группируйте по тенденциям и точкам пересечения.
Не добавляйте внешние причины (например, субсидии государства), которых нет на графике.

tasks.title: Daily Commute Modes in Three Cities
tasks.promptText:
The bar chart illustrates the proportion of commuters using four different modes of transport in three major cities (Amsterdam, London, and Toronto) in 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

chartSpec.title: Primary Mode of Daily Commute by City (2024)
chartSpec.subtitle: Percentage of adult workforce

outline: Introduction: Перефразируйте условие о доле пассажиров, использующих 4 вида транспорта в трёх городах в 2024 году.
Overview: Выделите ключевое различие — доминирование велосипеда в Амстердаме, общественного транспорта в Лондоне и личного авто в Торонто.
Body Paragraph 1: Сравните Public Transit (лидер в Лондоне — 54%) и Private Car (лидер в Торонто — 46%).
Body Paragraph 2: Опишите Bicycle (39% в Амстердаме против 9% и 5%) и Walking (8–13%).
pitfalls: Убедитесь, что сумма по каждому городу (100%) упомянута корректно как доли (percentages), а не абсолютное число людей.

tasks.title: Household Expenditure Shifts (1990 vs 2025)
tasks.promptText:
The two pie charts compare the average monthly expenditure of households in a developed country across five categories in 1990 and 2025.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

tasks.title: University Graduate Employment & Starting Salaries
tasks.promptText:
The table below provides data on employment rates within six months of graduation and median starting salaries across five academic disciplines in 2024.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

tasks.title: Global Water Withdrawal & Sector Usage
tasks.promptText:
The mixed chart shows global freshwater withdrawals (in billion cubic metres, bars) alongside the share of water used by agriculture (%, line) from 1980 to 2020.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

chartSpec.title: Freshwater Withdrawals vs Agricultural Share
chartSpec.subtitle: Bars: Billion m³ · Line: Agriculture share (%)

tasks.title: Mapledurham Village Development (1995 vs Present Day)
tasks.promptText:
The two maps show the layout of Mapledurham Village in 1995 and at the present day.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

outline: Introduction: Укажите, что карты иллюстрируют трансформацию деревни Mapledurham с 1995 года по настоящее время.
Overview: Отметьте переход от сельскохозяйственного поселения к застроенному жилому и коммерческому пригороду.
Body Paragraph 1: Изменения к западу от реки/дороги (сельхозугодья заменены на Lakeside Park, Primary Academy и Community Centre).
Body Paragraph 2: Изменения на востоке и в инфраструктуре (расширенная Main Road с круговой развязкой и новым мостом, Chelt Park Housing Estate, Supermarket и Business Park).
keyVocabulary: was replaced by / gave way to
to the east of / along the southern bank
pitfalls: Используйте компасные направления (north, south-east) и пассивный залог прошедшего/настоящего совершённого времени (has been replaced).

The diagram below shows how geothermal energy is used to produce electricity.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

tasks.title: Solar Still Desalination Unit

The diagram illustrates the structure and working principle of a solar-powered water desalination unit.

Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

tasks.title: Remote Work vs Office Collaboration
tasks.promptText:
Many companies now allow employees to work permanently from home. Some people argue that this harms team collaboration and innovation, while others believe the benefits outweigh the drawbacks.

To what extent do you agree or disagree that permanent remote work harms team collaboration and innovation?

outline: Introduction: Перефразируйте тему и сформулируйте чёткую позицию (например, частичное несогласие: хотя спонтанное общение снижается, продуманные гибридные процессы сохраняют инновации).
Body Paragraph 1: Признайте возможные потери в неформальном обмене идеями и адаптации новичков.
Body Paragraph 2: Аргументируйте, почему удалённая работа усиливает фокус, расширяет глобальный пул талантов и поддерживает асинхронную документацию.
Conclusion: Подведите итог без введения новых аргументов.
pitfalls: Не забудьте ответить именно на степень согласия ("To what extent"), а не просто перечислить плюсы и минусы.

tasks.title: Government Funding for Arts vs Public Services
tasks.promptText:
Some people think that governments should invest heavily in public museums, theatres, and art programmes. Others believe public funds should be directed exclusively toward healthcare, education, and infrastructure.

Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.

tasks.title: Automated Feedback Tools in University Writing
tasks.promptText:
Universities are increasingly adopting automated software tools to give students instant feedback on essays and assignments.

Do the advantages of this trend outweigh the disadvantages?

tasks.title: Urban Overcrowding & Housing Affordability
tasks.promptText:
Rapid population growth in major metropolitan areas has led to severe housing shortages and rising living costs.

What problems does this cause for residents, and what measures can governments take to address them?

tasks.title: Short-Form Media and Reading Habits
tasks.promptText:
Young adults are spending significantly less time reading long-form books compared with previous generations.

What are the main causes of this shift, and what effects might it have on society?

tasks.title: Ageing Populations in Industrialised Nations
tasks.promptText:
In many countries, life expectancy is increasing while birth rates are falling.

Why is this happening, and is it a positive or negative development for society?

tasks.title: Complaint About Cancelled Professional Workshop
tasks.promptText:
You recently enrolled in a weekend professional training course, but the sessions were poorly organised and one key module was cancelled without notice.

Write a letter to the training centre manager.
bulletPoints: Give details of the course you attended
Explain the problems you experienced during the weekend
State what action you would like the manager to take

outline: Salutation: Dear Sir or Madam (или Dear Manager), далее формальный тон без разговорных сокращений.
Paragraph 1 (Purpose): Укажите название курса, даты и причину обращения.
Paragraph 2 (Details): Чётко опишите организационные сбои и отмену модуля без предупреждения.
Paragraph 3 (Action): Запросите частичный возврат или бесплатный перенос и подпишите Yours faithfully.
keyVocabulary: I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with
I would appreciate a prompt resolution
pitfalls: Обязательно раскройте все 3 пункта письма и не смешивайте разговорный стиль с официальным.

tasks.title: Request to Landlord Regarding Heating Repairs
tasks.promptText:
You are renting an apartment and the central heating system has stopped working properly before winter.

Write a letter to your landlord, Mr Henderson.
bulletPoints: Describe the issue with the heating system
Explain how it is affecting your daily routine
Suggest convenient times for an engineer to visit

tasks.title: Advising a Friend Moving to Your City
tasks.promptText:
An English-speaking friend is moving to your city next month to start a new job and has asked you for advice on settling in.

Write a letter to your friend.
bulletPoints: Recommend the best neighbourhood to live in and why
Give tips on getting around the city
Suggest ways to meet new people locally

tasks.title: Four-Day Working Week Proposal
tasks.promptText:
Some employers are testing a four-day working week with no reduction in pay. Do you think this is a practical policy for most businesses?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.

tasks.title: Small Independent Shops vs Online Supermarkets
tasks.promptText:
In many neighbourhoods, small local shops are closing because more residents buy groceries and household goods online. Some people think this is an inevitable sign of progress, while others believe communities should actively support local businesses.

Discuss both views and give your opinion.

mockTests.description: Официальное письмо-жалоба организаторам курса + эссе Opinion о переходе на четырёхдневную рабочую неделю.
